Added 15 Nov 2026 at Ahmed's request, after the pre-registered run (amendment 6 in docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md).
Descriptive only: no rule or measure of the engine changes. "Hidden albuminuria" = adults >= 20 with diagnosed
diabetes or hypertension, not pregnant, ACR >= 30 mg/g and eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021) >= 60 on a single visit.

2021_2023.us_adults_with_hidden_albuminuria_note: sum of MEC weights of tested participants; complete cases, weights not re-adjusted for the ~1/3 without a lab, so an undercount

2017_2020.guideline: KDIGO 2022 Diabetes in CKD, Recommendation 1.2.1: "We recommend that treatment with an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEi) or an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) be initiated in patients with diabetes, hypertension, and albuminuria, and that these medications be titrated to the highest approved dose that is tolerated (1B)." Kidney Int 2022;102(5S):S1-S127, doi:10.1016/j.kint.2022.06.008
2017_2020.drug_matching: generic name matches /PRIL\b|SARTAN/ (signed by Ahmed Zayed, 15 Nov 2026)
